_comment: ADO error code knowledge base. Add new entries here — no Python changes needed.

VS403074.short: Work item type '{type}' is not enabled in this ADO project.
VS403074.action: Ask your ADO admin to go to Project Settings → Boards → Process → Work item types and enable '{type}'.

TF401320.short: A required field is missing a value.
TF401320.action: Ask your ADO admin to make the field optional or set a default value for it in the process settings.

VS402337.short: The work item is too large to save (description or attachments exceed the ADO size limit).
VS402337.action: Re-run with 'Skip file attachments' enabled, or split the card into smaller pieces.

TF26027.short: Work item type '{type}' does not exist in this ADO project.
TF26027.action: Check the ADO project process settings, or update type_config.json to map to an existing type.

VS403283.short: You don't have permission to create work items in this project.
VS403283.action: Ask your ADO admin for Contributor access on this project.

TF400898.short: The work item state '{state}' is not valid for this work item type.
TF400898.action: Update state_config.json to map to a valid ADO state, or ask your ADO admin which states are available.

VS403407.short: The area path is not valid for this project.
VS403407.action: Verify the ADO project has the expected area paths configured.
